title: A producer Alt-drags clips to copy them

steps.caption: BD and Sampler each have one clip, in bar 1
Drag across both tracks: both clips in bar 1 are selected
Alt-drag the BD clip to bar 3: both clips are copied
Alt-drag again: the copies are copied to bar 5
Turn on a step in the BD copy in bar 5
The BD clip in bar 1 is unchanged: the copy is independent
Reopened exactly as it was left
